xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4594: Dashboard Semgrep controls: Settings security section, per-project override, findings in issue view

plan.title: Dashboard Semgrep controls: Settings security section, per-project override
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Semgrep support (PAN-4585, #4590, #4591) is configured only by hand-editing security.semgrep in ~/.overdeck/config.yaml and verification.sast in ~/.overdeck/projects.yaml, and the managed install runs only from pan sync/pan install. The dashboard's whole-document settings save is lossy, so it cannot be used to write this block.
narratives.Proposal: Add a path-scoped read/write door for security.semgrep (src/lib/semgrep/settings.ts, validated by the existing normalizeSecurityConfig), a per-project verification.sast setter (src/lib/semgrep/project-override.ts), one route file with GET/PUT /api/semgrep/settings and GET/POST /api/projects/:projectKey/sast, a Settings → Security section with an install button that calls the existing POST /api/prereqs/install, a Semgrep gate control in Project settings, and the docs/changelog. The visibility half (sast skipped state, findings list) is split to PAN-5449. POST /api/prereqs/install gains rejectUnsafeDashboardMutationRequest (plan critique).
narratives.NonGoals:
- The sast skipped state in VerificationGatesPanel.tsx and the findings list in the issue view (moved to PAN-5449)
- Any change to GET /api/prereqs or GET /api/prereqs/:feature
- Any change to saveSettingsApi / writeYamlConfigPreservingComments or to src/lib/settings-api.ts
- Any edit to src/lib/projects.ts
- Letting a repo .pan.yaml set any security key
- Semgrep Platform/token fields (#4593) and CI setup (#4592)
- Polling GET /api/prereqs/useSemgrep, or an install progress bar
- Showing the per-project Semgrep mode in the collapsed Project settings summary
- Raising any file-size allowlist row

autoDecisions.summary: Split the visibility half (sast skipped state, findings list in the issue view) into sibling issue PAN-5449
autoDecisions.rationale: The full scope was about 29 files and 8 subsystems, over the 25-file/6-subsystem plan lint; controls and visibility share no source file, so a sizeJustification would not be honest. Precedent: PAN-4585 filed its children the same way.

autoDecisions.summary: The Security section edits every security.semgrep key, including mcp, edit_hook and timeout_seconds
autoDecisions.rationale: Those keys shipped after the issue was written and live in the same block; leaving them out would force a hand edit of the block the section owns.

autoDecisions.summary: API uses YAML snake_case keys and PUT accepts a partial patch
autoDecisions.rationale: 1:1 key-to-path mapping avoids translation bugs, and per-control partial saves cannot overwrite a key another control changed.

autoDecisions.summary: Validate with normalizeSecurityConfig on the merged candidate and refuse to write on error
autoDecisions.rationale: A bad value in security.semgrep makes every loadConfigSync caller throw, so the door must never write one; reusing the loader's validator keeps one set of rules.

autoDecisions.summary: Put the per-project setter in a new module, not src/lib/projects.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: projects.ts is 1212 lines against its 1217 allowlist cap and agents may not raise caps.

autoDecisions.summary: Add the mutation guard to POST /api/prereqs/install (plan critique)
autoDecisions.rationale: The route accepted unauthenticated loopback JSON and started installs; no caller besides the route exists, so the guard breaks nothing.

items.title: Add the path-scoped security.semgrep read/write door

expected_outputs: settings.test.ts passes with all seven named cases

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-1 exactly: new src/lib/semgrep/settings.ts exporting SEMGREP_SETTINGS_KEYS, SemgrepSettingsView (normalized config + pinnedVersion = SEMGREP_VERSION), SemgrepSettingsValidationError, readSemgrepSettings(deps?) and saveSemgrepSettings(input, deps?). Save validates the merged candidate with normalizeSecurityConfig (never re-implemented rules), rejects non-object bodies, unknown keys and empty patches, runs inside runSettingsWriteSerialized, replaces a non-map security/security.semgrep node with an empty map (D7), writes only the patched keys with doc.setIn (configs via doc.createNode of the trimmed list), writes with writeFileAtomic(path, text, 0o600), then clearConfigCache(). Tests use a mkdtemp config path via deps.configPath, never the real ~/.overdeck/config.yaml. PROBE: if the parsed document has YAML syntax errors (doc.errors non-empty), both read and save throw SemgrepSettingsValidationError and nothing is written.

items.title: Given a config.yaml with a '# keep me' comment, a jev: block and security.semgrep.mcp: true, when saveSemgrepSettings({ gate: 'blocking' }) runs, then the file still contains the comment, the jev block text and mcp: true, and now contains gate: blocking

Given saveSemgrepSettings({ gate: 'strict' }), ({ foo: 1 }), ({ configs: [] }), or any save against a config.yaml with a YAML syntax error, when it runs, then it rejects with SemgrepSettingsValidationError and the file bytes are unchanged
Given a config.yaml whose security key is null, when saveSemgrepSettings({ enabled: true }) runs, then readSemgrepSettings returns enabled: true
Given no security block, when readSemgrepSettings runs, then it returns the PAN-4590 defaults (advisory, ERROR, [p/default], 300) plus pinnedVersion '1.180.0'
Expose GET/PUT /api/semgrep/settings

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-2: new route file src/dashboard/server/routes/semgrep.ts modeled on routes/jev.ts, exporting semgrepRouteLayer = Layer.mergeAll(GET, PUT). GET returns readSemgrepSettings() or 422 { error } on SemgrepSettingsValidationError. PUT calls rejectUnsafeDashboardMutationRequest first, then saveSemgrepSettings(body); validation error -> 400 { error }. Register semgrepRouteLayer in server.ts next to jevRouteLayer (import near line 116, layer list near line 424). Add two no-loss-matrix rows after the jev block. Route tests mirror routes/__tests__/projects-merge-train.test.ts auth setup and mock lib/semgrep/settings.js. Unauthenticated mutation -> 401 from rejectUnauthorizedDashboardRequest. No route-scopes.ts row (PRD D17): scoped credentials, including per-agent MCP tokens, need admin.

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-5: add GET and POST /api/projects/:projectKey/sast to routes/semgrep.ts and to semgrepRouteLayer. GET: const project = yield* getProject(key) (Effect variant, never getProjectSync — projects.ts header forbids new sync callers in server code) or 404 { error: 'Project not found' }, then projectSastView(project, (yield* Effect.promise(() => loadConfigNoMigration())).config.security.semgrep). POST: rejectUnsafeDashboardMutationRequest first, 404, value must be 'off'|'advisory'|'blocking'|null else 400 { error: "value must be 'off', 'advisory', 'blocking', or null" }, await setProjectSastOverride, re-read the project with yield* getProject(key), return the view. Add two no-loss-matrix rows next to the merge-train rows. Tests mock lib/projects.js getProject (returning Effect.succeed), lib/semgrep/project-override.js setProjectSastOverride and config-yaml/load.js loadConfigNoMigration.
